excerpts: On Grok.com, your recent conversations are listed under "Chats" in the sidebar, and you can open your conversation history page at grok.com/history.

Grok.com Data & Account Deletion: On the grok.com website, if you want to delete a specific conversation, go to your conversation history page at grok.com/history, find the conversation, select "Delete" (the trash icon) on its row or in the "..." menu on its row, and then …
On a computer, these controls appear when you hover over the conversation.
